headline: October Home Inspections in New Milford
subhead: Key checks to prioritize for local properties before colder weather arrives this fall.
caption: If you are touring homes in New Milford this October, your inspection checklist deserves close attention. Many properties throughout the area rely on private wells and septic systems. Autumn is the time to schedule comprehensive flow and water potability tests, along with a full septic inspection, while the ground remains accessible and workable. It is also wise to have a qualified professional inspect the heating equipment, chimney, and roof flashing before freezing temperatures set in. Understanding the age and condition of these essential mechanicals gives you clear insight into upcoming maintenance needs before you finalize your purchase.
